protocol.before: uncalibrated original head-pivot + [0,0.22,0] world recipe; hand/chest have no before recipe
protocol.after: explicit role + per-attachment v1 profile + world-meter offset and optional orientation correction
protocol.calibrationMeaning: Synthetic hat crown is authored test metadata; VRM offsets are numerical probes, not fitted visual recommendations.

limitations: VRM tier reconstructs authored glTF node transforms only. No GLTFLoader/VRMLoader, meshes, expressions, springs or animation runtime.
VRM labels V01.. are ordered by file SHA256 and do not establish prior A01/A02/A03 identities or authorship.

Metadata rigs preserve authored GLB coordinates. The browser demo applies its explicit VRM0 forward-axis convention; report-only V IDs and browser profile IDs are separate, and numerical profiles must not be copied between these coordinate systems.
All supplied local files declare VRM 0.0; actual VRM 1.0 compatibility remains unverified.
Transform-pass does not establish visual hat fit, skin/hair clearance, human readability or real-device frame latency.
No live XRift, Quest, other-user view, host avatar API or published item validated by this runner.
Unsupported shear, reflected source bones, and singular transforms are covered by core rejection tests, not included as passing transforms.
